title: P0 live defects — Audit R1 closure: capacity release requires authoritative terminal evidence; per-orphan fault isolation in supervisor sweep
description: Audit R1 closure of PR #117's orphan-settle sweep (F1 mechanism + F2/F3 unchanged). R1-F1: capacity released only on authoritative terminal evidence — settleTerminalMissionOrphans now requires facts.observed_status to be a canonical terminal state (adapter-observed COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMEOUT). "No observation + no run_root" (adapter unbound, observe() threw, lost run_root) is weak evidence — stays RESERVED and re-probes on orphan_recheck_after; UNKNOWN_SIDE_EFFECT_STATE never auto-settles; operator acknowledgment remains the other release. R1-F2: each orphan is isolated in its own try/catch and re-read via tryGet before mutation — a concurrent writer (operator ack, barrier, sibling sweep) is absorbed not stomped, a version conflict skips that orphan and converges on a later sweep; supervisor.tick() wraps the sweep so even a systemic sweep fault cannot abort mission ticking. Idempotent: terminal_outcome excludes settled rows — repeated sweeps/restarts write no duplicate receipts, events, or slot releases. Regressions: 6 new R1 tests fail on R0 f7cb738 (weak-evidence settles + VERSION_CONFLICT escaping tick), pass on HEAD. F2 composeConfiguredRoleRoutes and F3 OBJECTIVE_ZERO_BUDGET unchanged.
